abstract: Using ball-arithmetic certificates checked by separately implemented verifiers, we establish $1.5064820 \le \mu(M) \le 6880083171681/2^{42} < 1.5643498$ for the area of the Mandelbrot set. The upper bound comes from a certified depth-17 dyadic quadtree (escape and a Koebe-type distance estimate with explicit truncation bounds); it is below Fisher and Hill's 1993 bound and the certified upper bounds we found, but above Förstemann's uncertified 1.53121. The lower bound sums certified area-theorem lower bounds over 3,352,592 hyperbolic components of periods 3 to 504 plus the exact period-1 and period-2 components; a stronger ball-arithmetic lower bound, above 1.50651, was published in October 2026 by the same method. Version 2: revised after an independent review; certificates and checkers are deposited separately.
author: Lindheim, Björn

revisions.reason: Independent review: withdraw the lower-bound record claim (stronger 2026 bound found), correct counts and coefficient description, add proofs, checkpoint warning and data DOI

title: Interval-certified bounds on the area of the Mandelbrot set
